proof_requests: Clear photo of the keyboard’s model label/sticker (back/bottom) so the exact Yamaha model can be identified.
Video of power-on and a full key test (all keys) plus pressing every visible button/controls.
Audio/video showing clean sound (no crackle) from speakers and (if possible) headphone output.
Photo of the adapter and a quick clip showing it powering the keyboard.
response.reason: The photos confirm it is a Yamaha keyboard, but the exact model is not readable and there is no powered-on/key-test evidence. Without the model and functional proof, a reliable worst-case price cannot be set from the comparables.
